headline_en: AI progress increasingly depends on better evaluation, carefully designed post-training data, and deliberate choices about agent autonomy.
headline_zh: AI 的进步越来越依赖更好的 evaluation、精心设计的 post-training 数据，以及对 agent 自主权的审慎决策。

items.en: OpenAI's Thariq, formerly on Claude Code at Anthropic, argues that models should be evaluated with an RPG-style stat sheet rather than a single leaderboard ranking. Comparing images generated by Claude and Codex, he credits Claude with better aesthetics, creativity, and endurance, while finding Codex closer to his intended outcome, which he associates with wisdom and alignment. He calls for evals that capture these distinct strengths.
items.zh: 现就职于 OpenAI、此前参与 Anthropic Claude Code 的 Thariq 认为，模型应该像 RPG 角色一样用多维属性表来评估。在一次图像生成对比中，他认为 Claude 的成品更好看，体现了 creativity 和 endurance，而 Codex 更贴近他的真实意图，他将其归为 wisdom 和 alignment。他呼吁设计能衡量这些不同优势的 evals。

items.role: Designer; worked on Cursor, Notion, and Stripe
items.en: Ryo Lu, a designer who has worked on Cursor, Notion, and Stripe, argues that the race toward recursive self-improvement is a series of human decisions, not an inevitability. He describes a shift from actively shaping software to watching AI return finished work, and questions concentrating control of increasingly powerful systems among a few labs. His central demand is accountability to everyone affected: risk estimates can inform decisions, but cannot determine what builders have the right to risk on others' behalf.
items.zh: 曾参与 Cursor、Notion 和 Stripe 设计的 Ryo Lu 认为，通向 recursive self-improvement 的竞赛是一连串人为决策，并非命中注定。他描述了软件创作从亲手把握细节转向观看 AI 交付成品的变化，并质疑让少数实验室掌握日益强大的系统。他的核心诉求是让开发者对所有受影响的人负责：风险概率可以辅助判断，却不能决定开发者有权替他人承担什么风险。

items.title: Inside the AI Training Data Market — Gabe Greenberg, G2i
items.en: The Takeaway: frontier labs increasingly need expert partners who can diagnose behavioral gaps and build trainable RL tasks, making data quality and iteration central to post-training economics. G2i CEO Gabe Greenberg says demand has shifted from thousands of mid-level annotators toward staff-level engineers creating complex datasets and RL environments, where verifiers, seed data, instructions, and task difficulty all matter: “if you make them too hard, they become evals.” He describes buyers moving beyond volume and correctness toward behavior and taste, prioritizing quality over a 20% price saving, and accepting nonexclusive datasets at lower prices; outsourcing remains attractive because managing large expert workforces introduces substantial operational complexity. For agent builders, a particularly useful observation is that computer-use models struggle to reconcile slightly different identities and project references across applications, making coherent, long-running data spanning tools such as GitHub and Linear valuable; for engineers entering this market, Greenberg emphasizes demonstrated agent-assisted development speed and the ability to produce tasks that meet the quality bar.
items.zh: 核心结论：前沿实验室越来越需要能诊断模型行为短板、构建可训练 RL 任务的专家伙伴，数据质量与迭代因此成为 post-training 经济性的关键。G2i CEO Gabe Greenberg 表示，需求已从数千名中级标注人员转向由 staff-level engineers 构建复杂数据集和 RL environments，其中 verifiers、seed data、指令和任务难度都很重要，正如他所说：“如果把任务做得太难，它们就成了 evals。”他描述，买方关注点正从数量和正确性转向行为与品味，宁愿追求质量，也不愿仅为节省 20% 成本而妥协，同时也会接受价格更低的非独家数据；管理庞大专家团队的运营复杂度，仍让外包具有吸引力。对 agent 开发者尤其有用的观察是，computer-use 模型难以对齐不同应用中略有差异的人员身份与项目引用，因此横跨 GitHub、Linear 等工具、连贯且时间跨度长的数据很有价值；对于想进入这一领域的工程师，Greenberg 强调实际展示 agent 辅助开发的速度，以及产出达到质量标准的任务的能力。

items.title: Emergent moral judgment in visual transformer models
items.en: LessWrong: “Emergent moral judgment in visual transformer models” reports evidence of moral-judgment capabilities in DINOv2, a model trained through self-supervision on images without text or labels. The project uses the Socio-Moral Image Database, whose human annotations cover moral goodness and emotional valence, to investigate whether moral concepts can emerge without explicit textual instruction. This offers an alternative setting for studying learned moral representations, while avoiding the difficulty of removing moral language from an LLM's training corpus.
items.zh: LessWrong 的《Emergent moral judgment in visual transformer models》介绍了一项研究，报告了 DINOv2 具备某些道德判断能力的证据，该模型仅通过图像进行 self-supervised learning，没有使用文本或标签。研究采用 Socio-Moral Image Database，其中包含人类对图像道德好坏和情绪效价的标注，以探索道德概念能否在没有显式文本指导的情况下涌现。这为研究习得的道德表征提供了另一种实验环境，也绕开了从 LLM 训练语料中清除道德相关语言的难题。

items.title: 最近3周自觉不错的projects推荐
items.en: tabris recommends 图1's local-first, self-evolving personal knowledge base for AI agents and also likes the newly released HoMe work, alongside 图12's portable memory layer for every AI agent. 图6 offers an agent skill for fixing model behavior with small weight changes, which the author finds somewhat useful, while 图14 presents DeepMind performance and capability benchmarks for open models as a learning resource for benchmark builders. Other recommendations include 图4's slide editor for presentations made with Manim and 图8's open-source AI filmmaking using your own models. Bottom line: 图1 (agent knowledge base), 图12 (portable agent memory), 图14 (benchmark-building reference), 图6 (model behavior fixes).
items.zh: tabris 推荐图1这个 local-first、可自我演进的 AI agent 个人知识库，简单易用、更新勤快，新鲜出炉的 HoMe 也不错；图12是适用于各类 AI agent 的 portable memory layer，做得很不错，值得推荐。图6是通过小幅权重调整修正模型行为的 agent skill，作者觉得还算有用；图14来自 DeepMind，提供 open models 的 performance 和 capability benchmarks，对搭建 benchmark 感兴趣的话，是不错的学习对象。其他推荐包括图4用于编辑 Manim presentations 的 slide editor，以及图8使用自有模型进行 AI filmmaking 的开源项目。一句话推荐: 图1（agent 个人知识库）、图12（通用 agent 记忆层）、图14（搭建 benchmark 的学习参考）、图6（修正模型行为）。

items.title: 审稿人最烦的三种论文写法
items.en: 鸭基米德 identifies three paper-writing habits that frustrate reviewers: overstating coverage, superficially borrowing theory from another field, and scattering the core contribution across the paper and appendix. The suggested fix is to begin with three sentences stating what you did, why it matters, and where the evidence is.
items.zh: 鸭基米德 总结了审稿人最烦的三种论文写法：做了两个数据集就敢写 comprehensive，硬借其他领域的 theory，以及想到哪写到哪，把核心贡献散在正文和附录里。作者现在的办法是先写三句话：我们做了什么，为什么重要，证据在哪。
